question: Why is the supreme seat designated by the name of praṇava?
premises: The seat is characterized as mere praise of excellence
inference: Because it is essentially the praise of supreme excellence, the seat is named praṇava
uncertainties: The precise nuance of prakarṣa+nuti+mātra+tvāt in this doctrinal context is interpretive
plain_english: Because it is essentially the praise of excellence, the seat is named praṇava.
